text:
Predicates:
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Premises:
Created(theLegendOfZelda, theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda was created by itself (or a specific entity, but the meaning is that it's the same game).
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(x, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
∃x (Game(x) ∧ x = theLegendOfZelda ∧ Top10(x)) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
